stem.text: A uniform rod XY of weight $10.0\,\text{N}$ is freely hinged to a wall at X. It is held horizontal by a force $F$ acting from Y at an angle of $30^{\circ}$ to the horizontal, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a horizontal rod XY hinged at X to a vertical wall shown in grey. A force F acts on the rod at Y, drawn at an angle of 30° to the horizontal, and a downward force of 10.0 N acts at the middle of the rod. A dashed line from X is marked with an angle of 60° and a right-angle mark. Labels: wall, X, Y, F, 60°, 30°, 10.0 N.
